content.caseIdentity: State of Karnataka v. Shivalingaiah, (1988) Supp SCC 533
content.holding: Where an assailant delivered a single squeeze to the victim’s private parts without knowledge of a heart condition, causing cardiac arrest, the act fell outside murder and culpable homicide, amounting only to grievous hurt.
content.relevance: Demonstrates the boundary between Section 100 culpable homicide and Section 116 grievous hurt in sudden single-blow disputes.
